brief:
The Israeli military detonated underground tunnels located beneath the Ali al-Tahir mountain range in Lebanon, the Ma'an news agency reported. The operation targeted a series of subterranean passages running beneath the mountainous terrain in the border region between the two countries.

The detonations represent a continued Israeli military operation in the area. No statement was issued regarding the specific purpose of the tunnel system, the extent of the underground network, or whether additional operations are planned in the region.
title: Israeli military detonates tunnels beneath Lebanese mountain range
